In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system is the first neural network system to achieve state of the art results for named entity recognition.
we have developed the first system that can perform well on NER with no feature engineering and only tokenized text.
our proposed method is a novel approach for NER that outperforms the state of the art on both the CoNLL and OntoNotes datasets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel architecture that automatically detects features for named entity recognition.

we have shown that a neural network can learn all of the information that is traditionally used in named entity recognition systems, and that it can learn this information without any feature engineering or lexicon construction.
, we propose a novel hybrid bidirectional LSTM CNN architecture that can be used for NER.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neural networks can automatically extract word and character level information that can achieve state of the art results in named entity recognition.
, given the right neural network architecture and a large amount of data, a lot of the traditional feature engineering can be replaced by neural network learning.
a simple neural network architecture, trained only on tokenized text, can achieve state of the art results on named entity recognition.
